deadlines.label: Fall 2027 application deadline
deadlines.note: UCSF Graduate Division's Fall 2027 timeline gives Monday, November 16, 2026. The BMS program page still shows an older cycle (November 15, Fall 2025).

timeline.interviews: Interview invitations by mid-December 2026. Interview week is February 1–3, 2027.
timeline.decisions: The site visit for admitted students is March 11–12, 2027.

english.note: TOEFL or IELTS for international applicants. Minimum scores and waivers are listed by the UCSF Graduate Division (graduate.ucsf.edu).

requirements.note: Letters ideally come from research supervisors.

funding.note: All admitted students, including international students, receive a guaranteed stipend plus tuition, fees and health insurance.

sources.label: UCSF Graduate Division: Fall 2027 program application timelines
